name: 2-6-dimethoxyphenol (syringol)
notes: Syringol is a lignin degradation product derived from sinapyl alcohol (phenylpropanoid pathway). ChEBI classifies as methoxyphenol plant metabolite.

name: D-galactose (AOS)
notes: D-galactose is an aldohexose monosaccharide. Carbohydrates do not fit any of the 7 main classes. Other is correct.

name: 4-(thiophen-2-yl)benzoic acid
notes: Synthetic aromatic compound used as Suzuki coupling reagent. No natural product class applies.

name: 2-methylbenzoate (o-toluate)
notes: Simple aromatic carboxylic acid. Not a natural product class.

name: 3-amino-2-2-dimethylpropanoic acid
notes: Non-proteinogenic amino acid analog but not a standard amino acid. Too synthetic/modified to classify as Amino_acid. Other is acceptable.

name: 2-3-dimethylcyclopent-2-enone
notes: Simple cyclopentenone. Not clearly a natural product class.

name: Pyrene
notes: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH). Environmental pollutant not fitting natural product classes.

name: Benzo[a]pyrene
notes: PAH carcinogen from incomplete combustion. Not a natural product class.

name: 1-methoxy-4-(methylthio)benzene
notes: Synthetic aromatic sulfide (4-methoxythioanisole). No natural product class.

name: 1-chloro-4-(methylthio)benzene
notes: Synthetic chlorinated aromatic sulfide (4-chlorothioanisole). No natural product class.

name: (-)-Norcamphor
notes: Norcamphor is classified as a bicyclic monoterpenoid (camphor analog without methyl groups). Should be Terpenoid.

name: Ethylbenzene
notes: Simple aromatic hydrocarbon. Industrial chemical. Not a natural product class.

name: 4-propylbenzoic acid
notes: Synthetic alkylbenzoic acid. No natural product class.

name: 1-3-7-trihydroxyxanthone
source: PubChem CID 5281635; Nature Comms; MDPI Plants review
notes: Xanthone from plants has mixed shikimate-polyketide origin. In fungi/lichens wholly polyketide-derived. NPClassifier and literature classify xanthones under polyketide pathway.

name: 2-naphthoic acid
notes: Simple naphthalene carboxylic acid. Xenobiotic metabolite. No natural product class.

name: Methyl 4-(2-fluoro-2-methylpropyl)-alpha-methylbenzeneacetate
notes: Fluorinated ibuprofen methyl ester analog. Synthetic pharmaceutical intermediate. Other is correct.

name: 4-(2-nitroethyl)phenol
notes: Nitroalkyl phenol derivative. Although structurally related to tyramine it is a synthetic/modified compound. Other is acceptable.

name: 4-methoxysalicylic acid
notes: Phenolic compound from Hemidesmus indicus but simple benzoic acid derivative. Not clearly phenylpropanoid (C6-C1 not C6-C3). Other is acceptable.

name: A 2'-unsubstituted isoflavone
notes: Isoflavones are a subclass of flavonoids biosynthesized via the phenylpropanoid pathway. Should be Phenylpropanoid.

name: (E)-3-hepten-2-ol
notes: Simple alkenol (C7 unsaturated alcohol). Not a natural product class.

name: 4-cyclohexylbenzoic acid
notes: Synthetic aromatic carboxylic acid. No natural product class.

name: 2-chlorotoluene
notes: Simple halogenated aromatic. Industrial solvent. No natural product class.

name: Clomazone
notes: Synthetic isoxazolidinone herbicide. Not a natural product class.

name: 3-(methylthio)benzoic acid
notes: Synthetic sulfanylbenzoic acid. No natural product class.

name: 4-(methylthio)benzonitrile
notes: Synthetic aromatic nitrile/sulfide. No natural product class.

name: 3-ethoxybenzoic acid
notes: Simple aromatic carboxylic acid. Organic synthesis intermediate. No natural product class.

name: Methanethiol (CH3SH)
notes: Simplest thiol. Small inorganic-like molecule. Not a natural product class.

name: Ammonium ion (NH4+)
notes: Inorganic polyatomic cation. Not a substrate in natural product classification.

name: Cyclotridecyl dimethylamino hexopyranoside
notes: Aminosugar glycoside likely from macrolide antibiotic. Sugar moiety alone classified as Other.

name: NADH (truncated SMILES)
notes: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide cofactor. Not a substrate natural product class.

name: 2-(1-methylethyl)benzenesulfonyl azide
notes: Synthetic sulfonyl azide reagent. No natural product class.

name: 1-bromo-3-ethylbenzene
notes: Synthetic halogenated aromatic. Building block for organic synthesis.

name: 5-methylorsellinate
source: Wikipedia Orsellinic acid; PMC; Frontiers Plant Sci
notes: Orsellinic acid derivatives are classic polyketide products of non-reducing PKS. Should be Polyketide.

name: Prenylhydroquinone
notes: Prenylhydroquinone contains a C5 isoprene (prenyl) unit on hydroquinone. Mixed terpenoid-phenolic but prenyl moiety is terpenoid-derived. Best classified as Terpenoid.

name: 4-ethylphenyl dihydrogen phosphate
notes: Phosphate ester of 4-ethylphenol. Synthetic/xenobiotic compound. Other is correct.

name: 2-fluorobenzoate
notes: Halogenated aromatic carboxylic acid. Simple synthetic compound.

name: (1S)-1-23-dihydroxy-24-25-26-27-tetranorcalciol
source: Biochemistry journal (ACS); Wikipedia Vitamin D; ChEBI
notes: Vitamin D metabolite (secosteroid). 1-23-dihydroxy-24-25-26-27-tetranorvitamin D3. Steroid/secosteroid classification is correct.

name: 5-Dehydroepisterol
notes: Sterol intermediate in ergosterol biosynthesis. 3beta-sterol. Steroid is correct.

name: (24R)-Hydroxycholesterol
notes: Oxysterol (oxidized cholesterol derivative). Steroid is correct.

name: 16Alpha-17Alpha-Dihydroxyprogesterone
notes: Pregnane steroid hormone derivative. Steroid is correct.
